title: Liquidity Sweep
short_description: Sweep of a prior swing high/low with a close back inside.
description: Sweeps the prior lookback swing high/low, requires a close back inside and a minimum wick ratio. The existing sweep factory and trade simulator handle execution when trade simulation is enabled.
hypothesis: Liquidity sweeps of recent swing extremes may mark short-term rejection; the hypothesis is unproven and must be tested across comparable samples.
research_objective: Evaluate sweep-quality variations under identical datasets, timeframes and ranges without changing the registered baseline.

confirmation_conditions: Close returns inside the prior swing.
entry_conditions: Bullish: current low < prior swing low - tolerance.
Bearish: current high > prior swing high + tolerance.
exit_conditions: Stop-loss, take-profit, timeout, ambiguity or end-of-data force close from the shared simulator.
implemented.invalidation: A bar without a valid sweep produces no signal; reset clears duplicate-timestamp state.
implemented.stop_loss: Signal-bar low for bullish sweeps; signal-bar high for bearish sweeps.
implemented.take_profit: Fixed R-multiple target, default 2.0R, recalculated at actual fill.
